thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Downtown Juneau waterfront / shops — adjacent framing — ~90 min.
Mendenhall Glacier — bus/tour; allow long buffer — ~180 min including transfer.
Mount Roberts Tramway — weather-dependent; hours Not verified.
Whale watching (organised) — only with guaranteed return.
Alaska State Museum — rainy-day option; hours Not verified.
thingsToDo.shortCall: ≥4 h. Downtown promenade + one nearby attraction; skip glacier if tender/queue risk exists. ≥90 min buffer.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Combine glacier + downtown only with overnight or a very late all-aboard; Juneau has no road connection to the rest of Alaska’s highway system for “drive onward” improvisation.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Identify whether you are on a city or private dock before assuming a two-minute walk to the same storefront block — CBJ itself distinguishes the two dock categories.
